changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment:
Fix invalid event_type values in cash_drawer_logs table and ensure the constraint is properly applied. This migration handles cases where existing data from server dump contains invalid event_type values that don't match the DrawerEventType enum.
Invalid values will be mapped to the closest valid enum value: - Any value not in the allowed list will be set to 'SALE_INFLOW' as a safe default - This ensures data integrity while preserving existing records
changeSet.sql: -- First, drop the constraint if it exists (in case previous migration partially ran) ALTER TABLE cash_drawer_logs DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS cash_drawer_logs_event_type_check;

-- Fix invalid event_type values by setting them to a valid default (SALE_INFLOW) -- This preserves the data while ensuring constraint compliance UPDATE cash_drawer_logs SET event_type = 'SALE_INFLOW'::character varying WHERE event_type::text NOT IN ( 'OPENING_BALANCE', 'SALE_INFLOW', 'SALE_REFUND', 'MANUAL_DEPOSIT', 'MANUAL_WITHDRAWAL', 'CLOSING_BALANCE' );

-- Now add the constraint with ALL DrawerEventType enum values included -- This will succeed because all data is now valid ALTER TABLE cash_drawer_logs ADD CONSTRAINT cash_drawer_logs_event_type_check CHECK (event_type::text = ANY (ARRAY[ 'OPENING_BALANCE'::character varying::text, 'SALE_INFLOW'::character varying::text, 'SALE_REFUND'::character varying::text, 'MANUAL_DEPOSIT'::character varying::text, 'MANUAL_WITHDRAWAL'::character varying::text, 'CLOSING_BALANCE'::character varying::text ]));
